actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE entirely NEW complete full-body REAR VIEW of adult Bunny from a blank canvas, facing straight away. This is a full new drawing, not a patch.
Image 1 is the sole authority for the character's rear pose, anatomy, hair, proportions, current clothes and socks. Preserve her slim long-legged silhouette, shoulder-waist-hip relationship, full rounded buttocks under shorts, back of the silver-white hair and relaxed hands. Image 2 is only the footwear board; use panel 04 REAR for the visible heel surfaces and the other panels only to understand parts that remain HIDDEN. Do not let front shoe details leak onto the heels.
Keep white closed-back sleeveless high-neck crop top with back center seam and band; red cuffed shorts with rear yoke, two rear pockets and central belt loop. Character LEFT orange thigh-high sock is SCREEN LEFT; character RIGHT white calf sock is SCREEN RIGHT. Add only a correctly handed red-white boot pair. The socks flow into the collars.
Shoe backs must exactly follow panel 04: red rear pull tab, red collar and heel counter, white lining/white heel panel, white midsole, large solid BLACK heel bumper with segmented black lugs. Each outside ankle disc is only a thin side edge: far LEFT on orange-sock left boot and far RIGHT on white-sock right boot. Gray connector on the outside where visible. Inner edges between feet are plain.
The smaller orange circles are on the FOREFOOT near the unseen toe end, well in front of the heels. Therefore there are ZERO small orange rings or circles anywhere on the visible REAR outsole/heel surfaces in this drawing. Do not copy the little toe rings from board panel 01 onto the rear. The heel rubber is uninterrupted black. Large lateral ankle disc edge may retain its orange rim. No front tongue plaques, crossing laces, silver toe studs, front eyelets or bows appear on the heel faces. Lace knot/tails are stored in front and hidden from this rear.

Body/boot fit: uniformly scale the ENTIRE reference figure about 96% for page layout on a 1024x1536 portrait, preserving every anatomical ratio and leaving roughly 50-60 pixels BELOW the socked-foot baseline for thick soles. Do not shorten calves or move ankles up independently. The original socked foot after uniform scaling fits inside the boots above the new outsole; retain its heel axis and foot room. Complete head and soles with clear margins.
Back anatomy is based only on image 1. No front clavicles, breasts/cleavage, abdomen or belly-button markings. The high shorts cover the sacral/waist-dimple marks: no diamond marks above the waist or relocated to the waistband. Smooth natural visible lower back; shorts conform to full buttocks.
Style matches image 1: Japanese 2D hand-drawn clean contours, silver-white hair with pale cool cel shadows, warm skin, deep red shorts, orange left sock and white right sock. Continuous flat color fields, limited crisp hard-edged shadows. No cloudy gradients, isolated white speckles, soft airbrush shading, mosaics, noisy texture or 3D gloss. Plain white background, one figure, no labels, no added gloves/devices/thigh straps/jacket/headgear/weapon.

source.baseline_role: Actual design reference in the recorded request; final drawing is native imagegen output, not a locally edited pixel parent.

actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE complete NEW full-body FRONT VIEW of the adult woman Bunny, from a blank canvas, as the next cumulative footwear layer. Do not paste or locally repair either reference.
Reference 1 is the authoritative current character and previous clothing layer: identity, slim long-legged body, face/head size, shoulder/waist/hip proportions, torso length, chest/hip volume, relaxed standing stance, silver-white hair, tiny ears close to the head, blue eyes, white high-neck sleeveless cropped top with front oval cutout, red rolled-hem shorts and asymmetric socks. Preserve these and the clean hand-drawn cel style.
Reference 2 is the newly clarified footwear direction ONLY. Its seven panels depict the RIGHT BOOT, with outer and inner faces clearly different. Adopt this exact red/white/orange/black shoe design and create a correctly handed pair for reference 1. No board, labels or other drawing from reference 2 should appear in the final.

View and left/right: strict straight-on front, full hair to sole, hands relaxed to sides. Character RIGHT leg is on SCREEN LEFT and wears the WHITE calf sock. Character LEFT leg is on SCREEN RIGHT and wears the ORANGE thigh-high sock. Do not swap them or add further equipment.
For the WHITE-sock right boot, its outer edge is SCREEN LEFT: large black-and-orange outer-ankle disc and small orange forefoot/outsole ring must both be on the far LEFT edge. For the ORANGE-sock left boot, its outer edge is SCREEN RIGHT: both external circular details must be on the far RIGHT edge. The two inner sides between the feet have NO large ankle circles and NO little orange toe rings. In this frontal camera the lateral ankle discs are only narrow edge profiles; never turn them face-on. Differentiate each large ankle disc (near the ankle) from its smaller forefoot orange ring (near the sole).
Each shoe: red high-top upper, white toe insert and collar lining, orange tongue under white X laces through black eyelets; closed red upper tongue flap with one gray three-slot plaque and THREE small yellow-orange squares. White knot and short tails stored inside the top tongue pocket, nothing dangling. Black front toe bumper with FOUR small silver studs, a single continuous white midsole, segmented black lug outsole with red sidewall blocks and the outer heel badge. The same exact components must be on both boots in physically correct left/right positions. Front shoes stay near-front-view rather than one being an exaggerated side view.
Fit: ankle discs sit beside the ankle joints, not halfway up the shins. Boot collars sit just above the ankles, socks flow continuously inside them, and the boots contain the existing feet. Add sole thickness below the footbed. Preserve anatomical body ratios and knee-to-ankle length; do not compress lower legs to keep the old barefoot ground line. Uniform scale of the entire figure for canvas margins is allowed; independent shrinking or shortening of legs/body is not. Leave clear white margin below the new soles, with no cropped hair or feet.
Art: Japanese 2D hand-drawn model-sheet illustration; clean confident outlines with a little line-weight variation; continuous flat local colors; sparse clean hard-edged cel shadows only. Match reference 1's silver-white hair, pale cool hair shadows, warm skin, deep red shorts and orange sock. Smooth red fabric planes without pale/cloudy patches. Plain white background, one figure, no text.
No gloves, wrist devices, thigh straps/boxes, jacket, harness, headgear or weapons. No proportion redesign, fattening, short legs, long waist, flattened hips, enlarged detached ears, skin-colored hair tufts, photoreal or 3D rendering, soft airbrush shading, mosaics, flecks or mottled cloudy texture. Portrait native canvas; target 1024x1536 if available.

actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a complete NEW full-body RIGHT SIDE PROFILE of adult Bunny, facing SCREEN RIGHT, from a blank canvas. This is a complete character drawing, not a patch or pasted footwear.
Image 1 is the accepted current side body and cumulative clothing. Its anatomy, face, head/body ratio, chest projection, short natural waist, rounded buttocks, hanging hand, thigh/calf proportions and white sock are authoritative. Image 2 is ONLY the exact shoe construction/palette; panel 02 OUTER is the visible right boot. No frontal-character reference is supplied.
Add only this red-and-white boot to the visible white-sock right foot. Maintain the precisely overlapped profile pose: far orange-sock left leg and its boot are naturally hidden behind the near leg, not forced into view. Same white sleeveless high-neck crop top with barely visible front cutout, same red cuffed shorts with side/back pocket placement, same white calf sock.

Composition and anatomical fit are essential: retain the complete body in image 1 at ONE consistent slightly smaller scale, approximately 96% of the reference figure, to reserve about 50-60 pixels of extra space BELOW the reference bare/socked foot for the boot sole on a 1024x1536 portrait. This is a whole-character layout adjustment, not a shorter calf or smaller foot. Keep head-to-body, shoulder-to-hip, thigh-to-calf and knee-to-ankle ratios unchanged. The original socked heel/sole position, after this uniform whole-character scaling, is the shoe's INTERNAL footbed; the thick outsole must lie BELOW it. Do not place the new external sole on the old internal footbed and push the foot upward. Keep the toe room and heel-under-calf axis anatomically plausible. Full hair and soles with white margins. Do not crop.
The ankle circle sits beside the actual ankle area, with the calf continuing down inside the shaft to the foot. Boot upper height modestly above the ankle, not halfway to the knee. Outer lateral right boot has toe pointing RIGHT, heel LEFT, clean white midsole over black segmented lug outsole and red sidewall blocks. Red upper, white toe insert, orange tongue, white crossing laces through black eyelets, white collar lining. Large black orange-ring disc near outer ankle; its short connecting link AND ROUND UPPER ANCHOR are SILVER GRAY, exactly as board panel 02. The round upper anchor is not red. Keep silver-gray hardware distinct from surrounding red fabric. The separate small orange forefoot ring is on the toe-side outsole at RIGHT; yellow-orange badge is on heel sidewall at LEFT.
Closed upper red tongue flap carries gray plaque with three vertical dark slots and three small yellow-orange squares. White knot and short tails entirely inside its top pocket; crossing laces visible below, no loose tails. Rear red pull tab. No front toe face artificially rotated to expose hidden details.
Preserve silver-white layered hair, blue visible eye, narrow close-fitting ear under side hair, warm skin and clean proportions. Japanese hand-drawn 2D linework with weighted contours, continuous flat local color and sparse HARD-EDGE cel shadows. Skin and red cloth have no cloudy mottled paint, white flecks, soft airbrush patches or grain. Keep chest and buttock volume from the primary reference rather than flattening them.
One full character on white background, no text. No gloves, devices, straps, jacket, headgear or weapon. No change in anatomical proportions or mixed front/profile anatomy.

actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a complete fresh full-color Japanese anime character design drawing, full head-to-toe RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE facing screen RIGHT, on pure white background.

REFERENCE 1 is the current accepted adult Bunny woman wearing socks. It is authoritative for her identity, exact visible body shape and proportions, pose, hair, ear, face, skin, top, shorts and sock colors. REFERENCE 2 is the newly approved boot design master. It is authoritative for the new footwear design, material color zones and its hard-edge two-gray ankle-anchor paint. The output is the same woman from reference 1 now wearing the boots from reference 2. Use only these two clear reference jobs. Render the entire new illustration, not an overlay or cutout.

Preserve the same silver-white layered short hair, blue eye, small close-to-head ear, chest volume, slim waist, rounded buttock profile, long thigh/calf relationships, shoulder and knee locations relative to body units, relaxed arm and natural five-finger hand. Same white sleeveless high-neck crop top and red cuffed shorts. Near/right leg wears the WHITE calf sock. Far/left orange leg is hidden by this strict side view as in reference 1; do not invent a new exposed far leg. Match the original complete silhouette and modest standing pose. No widening the body, shortening calves or making a long torso. Keep deliberate hard skin and clothing shadow shapes with clear boundaries. Hair, skin and red shorts must be clean cel regions without cloudy patches, mottling, white specks or blur.

Add the RIGHT BOOT from panel 02 OUTER of reference 2 to the sock-covered right foot, toe pointing right. Preserve the foot's plausible position within the boot and sock continuity at the shoe collar. The shoe sole adds height; allow room below the figure or uniformly scale the WHOLE figure if needed. Never squash individual leg segments or move the knee just to match old canvas edges.

CRITICAL TARGET: Look at the SMALL SILVER-GRAY circular anchor ABOVE the large black ankle disc in reference 2. It has TWO visibly distinct gray color regions: a pale upper-left face and a darker lower-right segment meeting at a hard straight diagonal color boundary. Paint this exact small gray cap in the output with that clear two-tone division, even at its small size. It is NOT a softly shaded round bead. No spherical glow or continuous gradient. Let color areas meet sharply without adding a physical seam, black incision, bevel ring or new component. The connector below it is gray with a hard dark side plane. This hard two-gray paint is only on the silver-gray small cap/link. Do NOT apply it to or recolor the LARGE BLACK ankle disc.

Copy all boot colors and pieces exactly from reference 2: red upper/tongue cover/collar exterior, gray cover plaque with three black vertical slots and three little yellow-orange squares beneath, orange instep underneath WHITE crossed laces and BLACK eyelets. Closed upper cover conceals white lace knot and short tails, while lower crossing laces stay visible. White collar lining, toe inset, side/heel insert and one white midsole. Large outer ankle disc has a WIDE BLACK outer face and BLACK central circle, with ONE NARROW ORANGE interior ring. Gray cap/link sits above it. The separate small orange ring is at the OUTER FOREFOOT near the toe, never on the rear heel. Yellow-orange badge on outer heel side block. BLACK front toe bumper (four tiny silver studs only where the viewpoint allows), BLACK contact lugs, RED heel and forefoot side blocks with black angled support between. No extra silver side rivets or white rectangular side panels. No glove, jacket, leg gear, weapon or other layer.

Hand-drawn clean ink plus strict hard-edge CEL colors throughout. Reference 2 shows the exact required gray-anchor treatment—copy its sharp light/dark break. No soft metallic gradient, soft painting, noise, grain, hatch, stipple, mosaic, random white flecks, or 3D material effects. Keep one complete profile figure, entire head and sole visible. Do not include the design board, swatches, inset examples, text or additional views. Portrait native 1024x1536 if available.

actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one COMPLETELY NEW hand-drawn anime footwear design breakdown board from a blank canvas. White landscape canvas, crisp weighted black outlines, flat red/white/orange/charcoal shapes, limited hard-edged cel shadows. The provided historical image is a footwear-shape reference only. It depicts a left boot in some panels; this new board must consistently depict the RIGHT boot, so do not copy its front-view left/right placement. Do not reuse its page title or explanatory writing.
Make seven numbered panels: 01 FRONT, 02 OUTER, 03 INNER, 04 REAR across the upper row; 05 SOLE, 06 LAYERS, 07 LACES below. Drawings dominant, neat small labels, no extra prose. This is an exterior design explanation, not engineering and no physical dimensions.

Every full shoe is the SAME RIGHT BOOT:
01 FRONT points at viewer: outside is SCREEN LEFT. The outside ankle black/orange circular clasp is seen as a narrow black-and-gray side edge just beyond the LEFT ankle silhouette, not face-on. Small orange ring on the outside toe bumper is at the far LEFT toe edge. The inside right edge has neither circular part. Four silver studs on the frontal black toe bumper. Do not turn this boot into an oblique view.
02 OUTER is true lateral profile with TOE POINTING RIGHT: show big orange-ring black ankle clasp at heel/ankle on left of this profile; short gray link joins it to red upper collar. Show separate small orange ring near the toe on the right. Red heel sidewall below the ankle has a small yellow-orange badge.
03 INNER is true medial profile with TOE POINTING LEFT: plain red-and-white ankle, NO big circle, no gray link, no small orange toe ring, no yellow heel badge. Same shoe silhouette and color-blocked seams otherwise.
04 REAR points heel at viewer: outside is SCREEN RIGHT, so the large ankle clasp is only a thin side edge at far right. Red centered pull tab, white padded collar lining, red heel counter, white heel region and black lugs align.
05 SOLE bottom view TOE POINTING RIGHT, show matching black segmented lugs, narrower waist channel, forefoot/heel orange inserts. No invented mechanical features.

06 LAYERS uses the SAME RIGHT-BOOT OUTER PROFILE, TOE POINTING RIGHT, but separates ONLY THREE exterior assemblies vertically with thin dashed alignment lines:
TOP: complete red-and-white UPPER with tongue, white crossing laces, white toe inset, collar and attached outer ankle clasp. It ends at a plain thin lower edge at foot level. It has NO white midsole band, NO black outsole, NO red protruding sole blocks, and NO yellow heel badge.
MIDDLE: one continuous solid WHITE MIDSOLE shape following the foot, and no red or black parts.
BOTTOM: one BLACK SEGMENTED OUTSOLE containing ALL protruding RED sidewall blocks, including the red heel block with its yellow-orange badge and the separate small orange ring on outer forefoot. Exactly ONE set of red bottom blocks, on this BOTTOM assembly only.
The three silhouettes line up and would reassemble into panel 02, without duplicated sole bands or red blocks. This diagram is simple visible component separation, no hidden internals, no fasteners, no claims about fabrication.

07 LACES has two isolated CENTRAL TONGUE close-ups only, with NO side ankle components or hardware in either inset. Left: lift the upper red tongue cover to expose a compact tied WHITE knot with short loops and two SHORT tails sitting entirely inside the orange upper-tongue pocket. Right: cover lowered, knot/tails hidden in the pocket; lower white crossing laces remain visible. The red tongue cover face has a gray rectangle containing THREE dark vertical slots and exactly THREE small yellow-orange squares beneath.

Consistent design everywhere: red upper, orange tongue underneath white crossed laces through black eyelets, white toe inset, white padded lining, white midsole, red accents on segmented black lug outsole; four silver toe bumper dots. Large outside ankle clasp and small outside forefoot orange ring are different pieces and never placed on the inner ankle/inner toe. Refined low high-top boot silhouette and believable foot room. No human body, no socks, no weapons or other equipment. Clean flat local colors, no airbrush gradient, mottling, white speckles or tiny noisy texture.

actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Make a COMPLETE NEW DRAWING, using three supplied visual references with different jobs. Reference 1 is clean uncolored lineart: it controls the exact silhouettes, geometry, design and composition. Reference 2 is the correctly colored accepted artwork: it controls EVERY component's color assignment and the identity, never the soft rendering of gray components. Reference 3 is a TWO-TONE GRAPHIC STYLE SAMPLE ONLY: it controls the hard two-gray paint of the small silver-gray circular anchors and gray links. Do not add the sample circle to the output, do not enlarge any anchor to its size, and do not borrow its layout. All output pixels must be newly drawn. Keep the entire scene, not a cropped detail.
The very specific required change from reference 2 is the small silver-gray circular anchor above the large BLACK ankle disc. Its face must be a flat pale gray region plus one obvious flat darker gray lower-right quarter, separated by a clean straight diagonal boundary exactly as visually demonstrated by reference 3. Let the two gray fill regions meet at a crisp color boundary WITHOUT adding a black line, incision, physical seam or new geometric part. The sample's diagonal line is not a seam; real component contours and actual seams are only those in reference 1. No continuous rounded shading, no bevel halo, no highlight bloom, no cloudy intermediate tones. Render corresponding gray links as flat gray with a hard dark side plane. This same two-tone hard division must remain legible at the anchor's actual small size. Gray components stay silver-gray; do not recolor them red, black, orange or white.
Use reference 2 to recover the precise local colors: red tongue cover and collar exterior; gray plaque with three black slots and THREE YELLOW-ORANGE little blocks; orange tongue only under the white crossed laces / within the opened lace pocket; white toe inset, collar lining, side heel insert and midsole; BLACK eyelets; BLACK toe bumper with only four tiny SILVER studs; BLACK segmented contact sole with RED side blocks. Large ankle disc has a WIDE BLACK outer body and BLACK center; the sole orange on that disc is the NARROW INNER ring. The small orange forefoot ring is a different piece at the toe end, not at the heel. Copy these exact assignments from the correct color artwork rather than guessing from the lineart.
Clean Japanese anime hand-drawn ink and hard-edge cel color. The large color regions are even local colors. Keep deliberate bounded shadow shapes; do not smear them into gradients. No random white specks, no cloudy stains, no grain, noise, crosshatching, stippling, dithering, mosaic or painterly wash. Pure white background. Preserve composition and proportions.
OUTPUT: the full landscape seven-panel RIGHT BOOT construction design board, same panel layout and labels as references 1 and 2. Top 01 FRONT, 02 OUTER, 03 INNER, 04 REAR; bottom 05 SOLE, 06 LAYERS, 07 LACES.
Preserve ONE right boot consistently: front outer side is screen left, outer profile toe points RIGHT, inner profile toe points LEFT, rear outer side screen right. The inner profile has no large outer ankle disc, link, forefoot ring or outer heel badge. The front/back only show the edge appropriate to the viewpoint. Every small panel follows the same right boot.
06 LAYERS remains a real three-piece exploded diagram with one upper, exactly one white midsole and one black outsole with red SIDE blocks. Removed midsole/outsole do not remain duplicated on the upper. Upper carries its ankle hardware and laces. Outsole carries the toe ring, red side blocks and outer heel badge. Shoe points right throughout.
05 SOLE: BLACK contact tread, exactly the original TWO ORANGE insert shapes at heel and forefoot; no extra orange chevrons, no red contact blocks.
07 LACES: open RED upper cover with ORANGE inner pocket, WHITE knot and short tails contained inside; closed RED cover with gray three-slot plaque/three yellow blocks. Preserve white crossing laces. No side hardware in these tongue-detail views.
Paint the gray anchors in BOTH 02 and 06 exactly in the two-tone hard diagonal style of reference 3. All other geometry and colors match reference 2. This is a visual design/construction board, not a manufacturing pattern. No extra swatches, no additional characters. Landscape native 1536x1024 if available.
